import numpy as np
def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = edge_distance.copy()
    n = edge_distance.shape[0]
    decay_factor = 0.1  
    threshold = 5  
    for i in range(n):
        u = local_opt_tour[i]
        v = local_opt_tour[(i + 1) % n]
        if edge_n_used[u, v] < threshold:
            updated_edge_distance[u, v] *= (1 - decay_factor)
        updated_edge_distance[u, v] += edge_n_used[u, v]
    return updated_edge_distance

import numpy as np
def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = edge_distance.copy()
    n = edge_distance.shape[0]
    decay_factor = 0.1
    threshold = 5
    penalties = np.zeros((n, n))
    decay = np.zeros((n, n))
    u_v_pairs = [(local_opt_tour[i], local_opt_tour[(i + 1) % n]) for i in range(n)]
    u_indices, v_indices = zip(*u_v_pairs)
    u_indices = np.array(u_indices)
    v_indices = np.array(v_indices)
    decay_mask = edge_n_used[u_indices, v_indices] < threshold
    decay[decay_mask] = edge_distance[u_indices, v_indices] * decay_factor
    penalties += edge_n_used
    updated_edge_distance += penalties - decay
    return updated_edge_distance

import numpy as np
def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    n = len(local_opt_tour)
    used_edges = np.zeros((n, n), dtype=float)
    for i in range(n):
        u = local_opt_tour[i]
        v = local_opt_tour[(i + 1) % n]
        used_edges[u, v] += 1
    max_usage = np.max(edge_n_used + 1)
    adjustment_factor = (max_usage - edge_n_used) / (max_usage + 1)
    updated_edge_distance += adjustment_factor * updated_edge_distance
    return updated_edge_distance
